user.title: EZVIZ Open Platform app
user.description: Create an app in the EZVIZ developer console of your region (Account Settings → Appkey management) and paste its AppKey and AppSecret.

data_description.region: The region your EZVIZ account belongs to. An AppKey only works in its own region.
data_description.app_key: Shown next to the app in the developer console.
data_description.app_secret: The app's secret, shown next to the AppKey in the developer console.

reauth_confirm.title: EZVIZ rejected the AppSecret
reauth_confirm.description: EZVIZ no longer accepts the AppSecret of app {app_key}. Paste its current AppSecret from the developer console.

data_description.app_secret: The app's secret, shown next to the AppKey in the developer console.

reconfigure.title: EZVIZ Open Platform app
reconfigure.description: Change the region or the AppSecret. To use a different app, add the integration again.

data_description.region: The region your EZVIZ account belongs to. An AppKey only works in its own region.
data_description.app_key: Shown next to the app in the developer console.
data_description.app_secret: The app's secret, shown next to the AppKey in the developer console.

error.invalid_auth: EZVIZ rejected the AppKey/AppSecret. Check both values and that the region matches your account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EZVIZ Open Platform.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This is a different AppKey. To use another app, add the integration again.

codes.title: Verification codes
codes.description: Pick a camera and type the verification code from its label (six capital letters). The card uses it so the code doesn't have to be in the dashboard. Cameras marked ✓ already have one; leave the code empty to remove it. Saving checks the code against the camera's video.

data_description.serial: The cameras of this EZVIZ account.
data_description.code: Six capital letters on the camera's label. Leave it empty to remove the stored code.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.description: How long recordings are kept in Home Assistant's media folder. Older ones are deleted automatically.

data_description.retention_days: Recordings older than this are deleted.
data_description.max_per_camera: When a camera has more recordings than this, the oldest are deleted. 0 keeps them all.

error.invalid_code: The camera's video doesn't decode with this code. Check it on the camera's label.

abort.not_loaded: The integration isn't loaded. Fix the account first, then try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not get the camera list from the EZVIZ Open Platform.
abort.no_cameras: This EZVIZ account has no cameras.

photo_failed.message: Could not capture a photo of {serial}: {error}

clip_failed.message: Could not record a clip of {serial}: {error}

camera_resting.message: {serial} didn't stream a moment ago. Try again in a minute.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the EZVIZ Open Platform: {error}
